products.title: MannTek DEC Dry Evotek Coupling for Chemical, Food and Pharma, Tank Unit — 1" to 3"
products.descriptionShort: MannTek DEC tank unit: a dry disconnect coupling with minimal dead space and FDA-approved wetted parts for chemical, food and pharmaceutical transfer. 1" to 3", stainless steel or Hastelloy, 25 bar, PED and ATEX 3G. Supplied by Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
The tank unit is the fixed half of a MannTek Dry Evotek Coupling, mounted on the tank, vessel, IBC or process connection. MannTek lists it for industrial process plant, road and rail tankers, IBC and ISO containers, and the pharmaceutical and petrochemical industries. A DEC hose unit couples to it.

MannTek developed the Dry Evotek Coupling (DEC) for the chemical, food and pharmaceutical industries. Dead spaces are kept to a minimum, so very little medium can collect inside the coupling: it drains and cleans well and the risk of product contamination is much lower. The coupling mechanism sits on the outside, which also makes the coupling itself easier to clean.

Like every MannTek dry coupling, the DEC opens the valves in both halves in one motion when it is connected and closes them before the halves separate. MannTek builds it to PED 2014/68/EU article 4.3 and ATEX 2014/34/EU category 3G, for liquid media and liquefied gases.

Sizes and connections

Five sizes: 1" (DN 25), 1-1/4" (DN 32), 1-1/2" (DN 40), 2" (DN 50) and 3" (DN 80). Threaded connections are BSP or NPT, and flanges are to EN. Each size is a row in the Sizes & Part Numbers tab.

Construction

  • Body: stainless steel 1.4408 (AISI 316) or Hastelloy, machined from solid bar
  • Flanged versions in one piece, with no screwed or welded flanges; eccentric-flange versions available
  • Seals: FKM, NBR, FFKM or PTFE
  • All wetted parts FDA-approved (MannTek)
  • Working pressure: 25 bar (MannTek)

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the body material (stainless steel or Hastelloy), the connection (BSP or NPT thread size, or EN flange rating), the seal material and the medium. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

products.title: MannTek rDME Coupling for rDME and LPG Blends, Tank and Hose Unit — 2"
products.descriptionShort: MannTek rDME Coupling: a dry gas coupling developed for renewable dimethyl ether (rDME) at any concentration blended into LPG. Anticlockwise connection prevents cross-connection with LPG couplings. 2", stainless steel, FFKM seals, 25 bar. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
MannTek developed the rDME Coupling from its Dry Gas Coupling (DGC) to handle renewable dimethyl ether (rDME) at any concentration, for blending rDME into LPG. It is listed here as tank unit and hose unit in the 2" size.

Why a separate coupling

To keep the highest level of safety and prevent cross-connection in the LPG industry, the rDME Coupling connects with an anticlockwise motion, the opposite of a Dry Gas Coupling. An rDME hose unit therefore cannot be connected to an ordinary DGC tank unit by mistake, or the other way round.

Specification

  • Size: 2" (DN 50), socket Ø 70 mm
  • Body: stainless steel
  • Seals: FFKM
  • Working pressure: up to 25 bar; MannTek optimised connection and disconnection at these higher pressures
  • Threaded (1-1/2" or 2" BSP, NPT or ACME) or flanged (ANSI, EN) connections, on tank unit and hose unit
  • Flow: up to 900 L/min (MannTek)

Where it is used

Loading and unloading road and rail tankers and ships, bobtails, and delivery to customer storage tanks: the same duties as a Dry Gas Coupling, for terminals and distributors handling rDME blends.

MannTek's LPG business development team presents the coupling in a video on MannTek's site. Like the DGC it opens the valves in both halves in one motion and closes them before the halves separate, so the line disconnects with minimal product loss.

MannTek's future-fuel range also covers LNG, methanol, ammonia, hydrogen and carbon capture. The LNG and cryogenic couplings, breakaways and emergency release couplings are on our LNG & Cryogenic Couplings shelf.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the half (tank unit or hose unit), the connection (BSP, NPT or ACME thread, or ANSI / EN flange) and the rDME blend. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

faqs.question: What is rDME?
faqs.answer: Renewable dimethyl ether, a gas blended into LPG. MannTek developed this coupling to transfer rDME at any concentration in LPG.

faqs.question: Why does it connect anticlockwise?
faqs.answer: So it cannot be cross-connected with ordinary LPG equipment. A Dry Gas Coupling connects clockwise; the rDME Coupling connects the opposite way.

faqs.question: Can I use a standard Dry Gas Coupling for rDME blends?
faqs.answer: MannTek developed the rDME Coupling specifically for rDME at any concentration, with FFKM seals. Tell us the blend and the installation and we will confirm the right coupling.

faqs.question: Which sizes are available?
faqs.answer: MannTek lists the rDME Coupling in 2" (DN 50), as tank unit and hose unit, with threaded or flanged connections.

faqs.question: What pressure is it rated for?
faqs.answer: Up to 25 bar working pressure. MannTek optimised it for connecting and disconnecting at these higher pressures.
